import unittest
from conftest import trace


def test_change_class_skip_after_collection():
    LaterSkipped.__unittest_skip__ = True
    LaterSkipped.__unittest_skip_why__ = "class-skip-changed-after-collection"
    trace("changed-class-skip")


class LaterSkipped(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        trace("must-not-dynamic-class-setUpClass")

    def setup_method(self, method):
        trace("must-not-dynamic-class-setup-method")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("must-not-dynamic-class-body")


class InstanceSkipped(unittest.TestCase):
    def __init__(self, methodName="runTest"):
        super().__init__(methodName)
        self.__unittest_skip__ = True
        self.__unittest_skip_why__ = "instance-skip-before-setup-method"

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        trace("instance-class-setUpClass")

    def setup_method(self, method):
        trace("must-not-instance-setup-method")

    def test_body(self):
        trace("must-not-instance-body")
